title: verify() all-fail Err: error message not diagnostic, no per-signer detail
description: When every signer fails, verify() returns Err(SmimeError::Io('all signers failed verification')). The individual per-signer failure reasons (message digest mismatch, bad signature, cert-chain error) are captured in SignerResult.error but are inaccessible when the top-level result is Err — the caller has no VerificationResult to inspect. The doc comment on verify() documents the Err condition but does not tell the caller how to get per-signer detail. Maintenance consequence: debugging a failing verification requires adding temporary Ok-path logic or reading internal state that is discarded on error. Any caller who wants actionable diagnostics cannot get them from the current API when all signers fail.
